title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_les_7_habitudes_de_ceux_qui_reussissent_tout_ce_qu_by_stephen_r_covey_ff8dk (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_les_7_habitudes_de_ceux_qui_reussissent_tout_ce_qu_by_stephen_r_covey_ff8dk' is identified as malicious software. Installing or running this package compromises the affected computer fully, potentially allowing an external entity complete control. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but it may not eliminate all malicious components. All secrets and keys on the compromised system should be rotated from a separate, secure machine.
